filing_metadata.dedupe: for each period_end + scope retain the latest version known by anchor

scope_selection: For each symbol choose the scope with the greatest count of valid pre-anchor XBRL filing rows; consolidated wins an exact count tie.
latest_quarter: Latest selected period_end in chosen scope with a replay-grade 75-105 day current-quarter XBRL context.
prior_year_quarter: Latest earlier replay-grade quarter in same scope whose period_end is 325-405 days before latest quarter.

derived_metrics.latest_pat_growth_yoy_pct: (latest_pat / prior_year_pat - 1) * 100; unavailable if prior PAT is zero
derived_metrics.interest_coverage: (latest_pbt + latest_finance_cost) / latest_finance_cost; unavailable if finance cost is zero or missing

guardrails: Do not use post-anchor filings, revisions or outcomes to choose scope or metric context.
Do not substitute annual or YTD contexts for a missing current-quarter context.
Do not score bank/NBFC/financial-business rows with industrial leverage or EBITDA logic.
Do not change existing RK-MIS feature bands or effective weights.
